name: 3D Fast & Furious
summary: 3D Fast & Furious is the sixth entry in I-Play's Fast and the Furious mobile game series and is directly based on the fourth movie in the franchise: Fast & Furious. The game's main mode is called Live the Movie and consists of nine scenes each with several events that have to be completed. There is one mission based on a sequence in the movie as well as one or several races. Each mission has its own objectives such as stealing gas from a truck or chasing criminals in a police car. The traditional races work the same as in the previous game in the series, Pink Slip, with the player being able to gamble his car against an opponent's. The race modes are also the same: cop chase, road race, drag race and drift race.
